title: Idempotent Payment & Billing Architectures
summary: Build zero-double-charge payment pipelines, audit-ready double-entry ledgers, and resilient webhook engines.

problem.headline: Double-Charging Bugs & Unhandled Webhooks
points: Network retries or duplicate clicks causing double charges for a single order.
Dropped payment webhooks resulting in silent revenue loss and user state drift.
Lack of immutable double-entry accounting ledgers for financial audits.

approach.headline: Cryptographic Idempotency & Double-Entry Accounting
points: Enforce strict cryptographic idempotency keys to prevent duplicate transaction execution.
Implement immutable double-entry accounting ledgers for audit-ready balance tracking.
Commit business logic updates and outgoing payment events inside a transactional outbox.

deliverables: Immutable Double-Entry Ledger database schema & execution library
Asynchronous Webhook Receiver with HMAC validation & deduplication
